notice: Release/QA checker registry. M4 implements the release suite in packages/core/src/checks.ts (runReleaseChecks): entries marked 'live' have a real implementation there; entries marked 'unsupported' are declared but have no implementation and report status 'unsupported' at check time (a required-but-unimplemented check blocks the release honestly). The separate 'data-assets' ruleset (numeric-mapping.fidelity/coverage, render.compile-proof, layout.visual-review) was implemented in M3. The 'draft' ruleset (draft.* ids, runDraftChecks) is fast source lint for ordinary writing against any compiled PDF: it gates nothing (requiredCheckIds is empty), and every draft.* id it runs must be registered here as 'live' (registry drift is an INVALID_REQUEST).

checks.implementation: core.checks: verifies the pdf artifact is the compiled output of a succeeded build.run job on the frozen snapshot
core.checks: build diagnostics + '??' markers in extracted PDF text
core.checks: section commands in snapshot sources vs output profile requiredSections
core.checks: every \includegraphics/\input/\include/\addbibresource resolves to a snapshot file + build MISSING_ASSET diagnostics
core.checks: multiset comparison of math/citations/labels/reported-results/quotes between baseline and current snapshot sources; differences produce a source-diff artifact and needs-review
core.checks + render-helper: every page yields extractable text
core.checks + render-helper: uniform page size across all pages
core.checks + render-helper: every PDF font resource embeds a font file (FontFile*)
core.checks: regex scan of source + extracted PDF text for emails, \author content, affiliations, ORCID, \thanks, corresponding-author markers; findings persist as a report artifact
core.checks + reviews table: every rendered page-image artifact carries a host review; flagged pages fail
core.checks: every requirement declared by the target's venue profile maps to a check that passed in this run
core.checks + render-helper: byte-compare then per-page text diff vs baselineArtifactId; differences produce a source-diff artifact and needs-review

core.checks: deterministic scan of de-commented source (\printanswers, solution/answer environments, \answer/\CorrectChoice, answer-key/marking-scheme text) + extracted PDF text (answer/solution labels); findings persist as an answer-isolation-scan report artifact

checks.unsupportedReason: teacher↔student question numbering/marks correspondence is not modeled

checks.implementation: core.checks: raw/generated snapshot assets round-trip through CAS under recorded blob hashes; generated-asset evidence records must carry resolvable sourceAssetId + recipeHash + parametersHash + produced artifact ids; results persist as an asset-provenance report artifact. NOTE: byte-origin provenance only — license attestation is still not modeled

core.checks: sums observed mark annotations (\question[N]/\part[N], '(N marks)', '(N 分)') against declared totals (\total{N}, \setcounter{totalmarks}{N}, 'Total: N marks', '满分 N'); a missing side reports needs-review, a mismatch fails

core.checks runDraftChecks: every \ref/\eqref/\autoref/\cref/\Cref/\pageref/\nameref/\vref (comma lists, ranges, \hyperref[key]) in the comment-masked sources reachable from the target root must match a \label (or label= option) in some project .tex file; unmatched → fail/warning with path:line (needs-review when xr \externaldocument is loaded)
core.checks runDraftChecks: a \label key defined more than once across the scanned sources → fail/error listing every path:line

core.checks runDraftChecks: cite keys (\cite, natbib and biblatex families incl. optional args, comma lists, multicite) must exist in the declared bibliography — .bib entries parsed by core.bib (\bibliography/\addbibresource, filecontents), \bibitem for thebibliography, a shipped .bbl only when a database is unresolved; missing keys or unresolved databases → fail/error; no citations → not-applicable

core.checks runDraftChecks: entries of the declared .bib databases / thebibliography that are never cited (case-insensitive) → fail with severity info (hygiene only, never blocking); \nocite{*} → not-applicable

core.checks runDraftChecks: figure/table floats (incl. starred, wrap/sideways/SC variants) without \caption, numbered captions without \label, or labelled floats never referenced → fail/warning with path:line

core.checks runDraftChecks: TODO/FIXME/XXX/TBD and 待补充/待完善 markers, \todo/\missingfigure, \lipsum/\blindtext, 'lorem ipsum', '??' in prose, empty sectioning titles and an empty abstract → fail/warning. Scans comment-masked source only: TODOs inside % comments are legitimate and never reported

core.checks runDraftChecks: conservative prose heuristics outside math, verbatim, code environments, URL/key/path arguments and comments — straight "…" quotes, '...' instead of \dots, a breakable space before \ref/\eqref/\pageref (Latin words or 图/表/式) or a plain \cite (Latin context), immediately repeated Latin words; CJK text never matches. fail with severity info, at most 40 findings listed

core.checks runDraftChecks: summarizes the stored buildResult diagnostics of the build job that produced the pdf (overfull boxes > 1pt with path:line, undefined references/citations, multiply-defined labels, missing glyphs) plus LaTeX font-substitution warnings from the log artifact → fail/warning when present; unsupported when the producing job stored no build result
